title: Zahra and the Bridge Back
subtitle: Repair can be offered; it cannot be forced
description: The words had stopped. The friendship hadn't. After a blaming line breaks the conversation, Zahra learns to name the specific problem, offer repair and leave Leo free to decide when he is ready. The final page gives parents, carers and educators a key message and practical ideas for shared discussion and rehearsal.
